title: Press Play!
theme: Disney+ original series and films, from The Mandalorian to Hocus Pocus 2
intro: [excited] Grab the remote, the snacks and the comfiest blanket in the house! Tonight is PRESS PLAY, all about Disney Plus originals. [laughs] If you have ever said just one more episode at two in the morning... this board is for you.

art.prompt: Wide 16:9 title card: a cozy living room at night lit only by a giant glowing TV screen showing a swirling starfield, popcorn bowls and a fuzzy blanket on the couch, a remote control on the cushion, light beams forming shapes of a spaceship, a witch's candle and a city skyline No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: This Is the Way
categories.intro: [dramatic] This... is the way. Our film-and-series category is The Mandalorian, the show that launched Disney Plus in 2019.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a battered silver bounty hunter's helmet resting on a rocky desert planet ridge under two suns, a small floating hover-pram glowing nearby, dust swirling, cinematic sci-fi lighting No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Fans first called him Baby Yoda, but the little green foundling's real name is this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Grogu! [gasps] Those ears! That little sip of soup! Cutest thing in the galaxy.

clues.clue: The Mandalorian's real name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Din Djarin! [chuckles] Most folks just call him Mando. He's not much of a talker.

clues.clue: This actor plays Din Djarin.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pedro Pascal! [laughs] He spends most of the show under a helmet, and still makes us cry.

clues.clue: This director and actor created The Mandalorian.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jon Favreau! [excited] Yes, the same guy who directed Iron Man and played Happy Hogan. Busy man.

clues.clue: This composer wrote The Mandalorian's theme music, and won Oscars for Black Panther and Oppenheimer.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Ludwig Goransson! He played a lot of that theme on a recorder. Yes, the instrument from music class.

categories.title: Streaming Sensations
categories.intro: [excited] This themed category is a channel-surf through Disney Plus hits. Witches, sitcoms and time cops. Let's binge!

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a wall of floating glowing TV screens of all eras, from a black-and-white 1950s set to a sleek modern panel, each one showing abstract swirls of color, a spellbook and a sci-fi clock floating among them No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Hocus Pocus 2 brought back this trio of witches.
clues.reveal: [mischievously] The correct answer is the Sanderson Sisters! Winifred, Mary and Sarah. [laughs] Amok, amok, amok!

clues.clue: The sitcom-style New Jersey town where WandaVision takes place.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Westview! [chuckles] Every decade of TV in one little town. And Agnes was behind it all along.

clues.clue: In Loki, the agency that polices the timeline goes by these three letters.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the TVA, the Time Variance Authority! [laughs] Their mascot is a talking clock named Miss Minutes. Paperwork has never been so cute.

clues.clue: Hocus Pocus 2 premiered on Disney Plus in this year, 29 years after the original film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2022! [excited] 1993 plus 29. The witches were back, and so was the black flame candle.

clues.clue: This actor stars as Cassian Andor in the Star Wars series Andor.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Diego Luna! [sighs] He first played Cassian in Rogue One back in 2016. Andor tells the story before that.

categories.title: Stream Scenes
categories.intro: [excited] It's PICTURE time! Each picture shows a scene from a Disney Plus original series or movie. No faces, just clues. Name the show.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a movie-theater-style screen glowing in a dark room with silhouettes of objects drifting out of it: a black candle, a basketball, a purple archery bow and a bronze pen, starry cinematic light No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the movie.
clues.reveal: [mischievously] The correct answer is Hocus Pocus 2! Light the black flame candle and the Sanderson Sisters come back. [laughs] Please don't try that at home.

media.prompt: A tall black candle burning with an eerie pale flame in a dusty old Salem witch's cottage, a leathery spellbook with a single stitched eye clasp on a table, full moon in the window and fallen autumn leaves. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the series.
clues.answer: High School Musical: The Musical: The Series
accept: high school musical the musical the series
high school musical: the musical: the series
choices: High School Musical: The Musical: The Series
clues.reveal: The correct answer is High School Musical: The Musical: The Series! [laughs] Possibly the longest title ever. We're all in this together.

media.prompt: An empty high school auditorium stage with red velvet curtains half open, a basketball resting under the spotlight beside a script and a pair of sneakers, school lockers visible through the side door. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the series.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hawkeye! [chuckles] Trick arrows, snowy New York and Christmas. Superhero holiday cheer.

media.prompt: A sleek purple archery bow and a quiver of high-tech trick arrows leaning against a decorated Christmas tree in a snowy New York apartment, an ice rink and city lights glowing through the window. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the series.
choices: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
clues.reveal: The correct answer is WandaVision! [gasps] A black-and-white sitcom living room slowly bleeding into color. Something is VERY wrong in that suburb.

media.prompt: A 1950s suburban living room filmed in black and white, with a boxy television and a couch, where vivid red color is slowly seeping in from one corner and the edges glitch like a broken broadcast. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the series.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Percy Jackson and the Olympians! That's a bronze pen called Riptide that turns into a sword. Best school supply ever.

media.prompt: A bronze ballpoint pen glowing and morphing into a gleaming Greek bronze sword on the wooden dock of a summer camp lake, a lightning bolt crackling across a stormy sky and Greek columns on the shore. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: From Screen to Scene
categories.intro: [excited] Our parks category is where streaming meets the theme parks. Docuseries, haunted specials and a galaxy far, far away.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a theme-park pathway lit by lanterns leading to a mysterious hillside mansion on one side and a rugged sci-fi spaceport on the other, a vintage film camera on a tripod in the foreground No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: At Disneyland and Hollywood Studios, you can pilot the Millennium Falcon in this land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge! [laughs] Punch it, Chewie. Just maybe don't crash into the walls, like I did.

clues.clue: This 2021 Dwayne Johnson movie, based on a classic riverboat ride, debuted in theaters and on Disney Plus Premier Access.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jungle Cruise! [chuckles] It's loaded with ride puns. Just like this show. You're welcome.

clues.clue: The 2019 Disney Plus docuseries The Imagineering Story is about the designers who build the parks. What does Disney call them?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Imagineers! [excited] Imagination plus engineering. Best job title on the planet.

clues.clue: In a 2021 Disney Plus Halloween special, Gonzo spends a spooky night in this attraction.
choices: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is The Haunted Mansion! Muppets Haunted Mansion. Nine hundred ninety nine happy haunts, and one very nervous Gonzo.

clues.clue: The Imagineering Story was directed by this filmmaker, the granddaughter of Mickey co-creator Ub Iwerks.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Leslie Iwerks! The granddaughter of the man who drew Mickey told the story of the people who built the parks. Full circle!

categories.title: Plus-Size Trivia
categories.intro: [chuckles] Our fan category is about Disney Plus itself. Launch days, brand tiles and surprise premieres. [whispers] Your watch history can't help you now.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a giant glowing play button floating above a city of stacked streaming tiles like a candy-colored skyline, a calendar page flying past, confetti and spotlights No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Disney Plus launched in the United States in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2019! [excited] November 12th, 2019. Sleep schedules have never been the same.

clues.clue: The Disney Plus home screen has brand tiles for Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars and this yellow-bordered brand.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is National Geographic! [chuckles] That famous yellow rectangle. Penguins, sharks and space, all one click away.

clues.clue: This live-action remake, starring a real rescue dog, premiered on Disney Plus on launch day in 2019.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lady and the Tramp! [laughs] The dog who played Tramp was a real shelter pup named Monte. Good boy!

clues.clue: In July 2020, Disney Plus premiered the filmed stage version of this Broadway smash by Lin-Manuel Miranda.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hamilton! [excited] Not throwing away my shot... at this answer.

clues.clue: Anna Kendrick played Santa's daughter in this Disney Plus launch-day holiday movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Noelle! [chuckles] Santa retires, his son panics, and his daughter saves Christmas. Classic.
